policy: Every transcription must cite a stable archive or edition locator; unverified text is never presented as ground truth.

records.title: Analysis situs
records.critical_edition: Gerhardt, Die mathematischen Schriften, vol. 7 (Berlin: A. Asher, 1863), pp. 178-184 (section 'De Analysi situs'); public-domain scan: https://archive.org/details/leibnizensmathe07leibgoog, leaves 194-200
records.notes: Citation corrected: this text is in Gerhardt vol. 7, not vol. 5 (confirmed against the scan's table of contents and page mapping: printed p. 141 = leaf 157, so printed pp. 178-184 = leaves 194-200). Acquire the archive folio scan for the manuscript witness (LH XXXV, 1, 9) before publishing a diplomatic transcription; the Gerhardt edition witness is available via the scan above.

records.title: Initia rerum mathematicarum metaphysica
records.critical_edition: Gerhardt, Die mathematischen Schriften, vol. 7 (Berlin: A. Asher, 1863), pp. 17-29; critical reference: Akademie-Ausgabe, series VII (mathematical writings), where applicable; public-domain scan: https://archive.org/details/leibnizensmathe07leibgoog, leaves 28-40
records.notes: The Gerhardt edition witness (GM VII 17-29) is public domain and available via the scan above (printed p. 17 = leaf 28; the 5-leaf front-matter offset ends before printed p. 40). Edition pagination must be recorded alongside folio and image identifiers.

records.title: De progressione dyadica
records.critical_edition: Not printed in Gerhardt's Die mathematischen Schriften (verified: no 'dyadica' text in the vol. 7 scan; the 1679 manuscript was first published only in facsimile, with German translation, in Hochstetter, Greve & Gumin (eds.), 'De Progressione Dyadica: Faksimile' (Munich/Vienna: R. Oldenbourg, 1979), which is in copyright).
records.notes: Citation corrected: the earlier 'Gerhardt vol. 5' attribution was wrong. The 1979 facsimile remains under rights; transcription stays blocked pending witness access. The public-domain binary-arithmetic text is the published 1703 'Explication de l'Arithmetique Binaire' (Histoire de l'Academie Royale des Sciences, Paris, 1703), a separate witness that could be catalogued independently. Bibliographic details of the 1979 facsimile confirmed against secondary literature; flag for review when the volume is inspected directly.
